note: Every path adopt seeds into a project by copying its bytes, tracked in the manifest. A project gets the loop as well as the rules: .claude/skills/ and .claude/commands/ carry pick-work and /work, and docs/roles/ carries one guide per role. An entry ending in / expands to every file under it, so a file landing on another branch joins this list when it lands. The bin/ entries are named one by one because bin/adopt is this template's own tool and does not belong in a project it seeded. template_only subtracts from a directory expansion for that same reason: the adopt skill and the /agentkit command drive bin/adopt, and a project is adopted from an agentkit checkout on a rerun as much as on a first run, so a project needs none of the three. Naming every other skill and command one by one instead would drop one from every project the moment somebody adds one here. CLAUDE.md is absent because a project's router is rendered from adopt's answers rather than copied: this repository's copy describes agentkit, and a project's carries its own name, summary and open questions. .github/workflows/ is absent for a second reason: a tracked file is replaced on every rerun and the project's version moves to a .local sidecar, and GitHub runs no .local, so a project that had tuned its workflow would silently be running this repository's copy. adopt renders both workflows from the pack and seeds them once.
